pulls.author: shipilev
pulls.body_excerpt: I noticed in workloads that have explicit GCs and low (or unset) Xms that we uncommit very aggressively, which eats performance. This change does much lazier commits, with deliberate waits between region uncommits. This allows application to swoop in more promptly and claim empty regions for allocations, which saves a trip through uncommit->commit sequence. Since uncommit is now running for longer, it is now profitable to figure out the uncommit plan right away, sort regions by target uncommit time and (slowly) work through them. pulls.body_excerpt: See the JBS issue for the full explanation of the issue. pulls.title: 8372701: Randomized profile counters
pulls.author: theRealAph
pulls.body_excerpt: Please use [this link](https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/pull/28541/changes?w=1) to view the files changed. Profile counters scale very badly. pulls.title: 8303762: Optimize vector slice operation with constant index using VPALIGNR instruction
pulls.author: jatin-bhateja
pulls.body_excerpt: Patch optimizes Vector. slice operation with constant index using x86 ALIGNR instruction. It also adds a new hybrid call generator to facilitate lazy intrinsification or else perform procedural inlining to prevent call overhead and boxing penalties in case the fallback implementation expects to operate over vectors. The existing vector API-based slice implementation is now the fallback code that gets inlined in case intrinsification fails.
